# architecture.md — NexCredit
## Generated by Scriptwall Compass on 2026-05-22

## System Overview
React Native mobile app drives borrower onboarding and loan flow; FastAPI backend orchestrates identity, fraud, eligibility, lending, and payment adapters; admin/ops interfaces support review and control in a human-in-the-loop model; Dockerized local stack with migration/seed pipeline.

## Major Components
| Component | Purpose | Location |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| Mobile App (React Native) | Borrower onboarding, verification progression, offer acceptance, and repayment-facing UX for first-time and returning users. | `mobile-app/` |
| Backend API (FastAPI) | Workflow orchestration, persistence, eligibility/loan processing, provider abstraction/fallback responses, and audit/event handling. | `backend services in repository (FastAPI stack)` |
| Database + Migrations | Persist borrower, application, stage, and operational records including interim BVN/credit-score placeholders. | `infra/migrations and Alembic pipeline` |
| Admin/Ops Tooling | Internal visibility and actionability for review, approvals, and operational monitoring. | `admin-related modules in repository` |
| Provider Adapter Layer | Integrate identity, bank verification, and payments with fallback behavior when providers are unavailable. | `backend integration modules/adapters` |
| Local Dev Orchestration | Containerized startup and reproducible local environment. | `docker compose + .env/.env.example` |

## Data Flow
Borrower actions from mobile call backend endpoints for each checkpoint. Backend validates business rules, persists state transitions, and either calls external providers or returns schema-valid fallback payloads. Critical transitions emit audit traces and become visible to admin flows. Mobile stage rendering and resume logic must map strictly to persisted backend states, with idempotent handling for retries and callbacks.

## Known Weak Points
- ⚠ First-offer acceptance write path is not reliably persistent under network instability.
- ⚠ Onboarding stage calculation and display can drift from backend truth.
- ⚠ AsyncStorage-heavy local state contributes to resume inconsistencies.
- ⚠ Fallback/mock strategy lacks explicit environment gating and retirement controls.
- ⚠ Temporary BVN/credit-score contracts create migration and compatibility debt.
- ⚠ No automated tests detected for critical flow regression prevention.
- ⚠ Documentation inconsistency exists between older recovery prompt sprint label and current sprint status.
